procedure_steps.instruction: Apply 1-2% lead/cadmium nitrate sample solution to 4 by 17 cm paper with baseline 3 cm from its end.
procedure_steps.observation: Dry sample spots are above the mobile-phase level.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.
